debug_enabled.description: Enables netlink message debugging when iw is executed. Corresponds to the --debug flag.

regulatory_domain.description: The ISO/IEC 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the regulatory domain to enforce. Used with 'iw reg set'. Default '00' allows all channels.

interface.description: The network interface name to target by default. Corresponds to the 'dev <interface name>' object.
